title: breakpoint2
description: This allows you to set a breakpoint within the code.

file.description: The name of the file to set a breakpoint in.

lineNumber.description: The line number within the file to set a breakpoint on.

class.description: The name of the class that owns the function you are setting a breakpoint on.

functionName.description: The name of the function within the class to set a breakpoint on.

offset.description: The memory offset from the start of the function to set a breakpoint on.
